module: Node "EndScreen Results" (repeat_instant, color ui). Adds the mission results panel to the end screen: formatted text of the attempt (change.formattedAttempt), optional subtext, then optionally objectives and ratings. Inputs: flow, text (string or table), change (attempt aggregate table), includeObjectives, includeRatings (bool). Output: flow (chainFlow).
notes: If includeObjectives or includeRatings is true while change is nil, addObjectives/addRatings receive nil.

C.desc: Flowgraph node class; each instance represents a node in a graph.

work.desc: Copies flow. Adds a textPanel (header "ui.missions.results.title" only once) for change.formattedAttempt and/or for text, then calls modules.ui:addObjectives / addRatings with change if the options are checked.
